Whether you are a first-time user, a busy family or a corporate client, one of the seven plans below will fit.

faqs.q: Can I use package credit for dry cleaning, or only laundry?
faqs.a: Any service, no exceptions. The credit works for wash & fold, dry cleaning, steam ironing, curtain cleaning, shoe care — everything we offer. There are no category restrictions.

faqs.q: What happens if my plan expires before I use the full credit?
faqs.a: Gold, Diamond and Platinum are time-limited (90 days, 6 months and 1 year), so pick a validity that matches how much you actually send us. Elite, Premier, Founder and VIP credit never expires — if you are unsure, start with one of those.

faqs.q: Can I get a refund on unused credit?
faqs.a: Package credit is prepaid and non-refundable. The unlimited-validity plans exist precisely so you are never under time pressure to use a balance.

faqs.q: Is GST included in the package price?
faqs.a: No. Package prices are exclusive of GST, which is applied as per government norms at the time of purchase. The package value you receive is your full spendable balance.

faqs.q: Can I share a package with family or flatmates?
faqs.a: Yes. One package can cover multiple addresses on the same account — book pickups from wherever you need and the same balance covers them.

faqs.q: Do corporate clients get extra benefits?
faqs.a: Yes. On Premier, Founder and VIP we offer custom SLAs and invoicing, volume discounts on recharges, priority scheduling for bulk orders, and a dedicated account manager on VIP. Email care@wash4you.in to set one up.

faqs.q: Can I upgrade my package before it expires?
faqs.a: Yes. Pay the difference and we will move you up a tier — your existing balance rolls into the new plan.

faqs.q: How do I check my remaining balance?
faqs.a: Message us on WhatsApp and we will tell you. We also send a balance update after every order, so you are never guessing.

faqs.q: What is the difference between Founder and VIP?
faqs.a: Both have unlimited validity. VIP gives you more value (₹75,000 for ₹50,000, a ₹25,000 saving, against ₹42,000 for ₹30,000 on Founder), top-priority scheduling and a dedicated account manager.
